{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# First, confirm the 6 entries with commas
comma_mask = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print("Rows with commas in revenue:")
print(sales.loc[comma_mask, 'revenue'])

# Clean: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check the cleaned column
print("\nFirst few cleaned revenue values:")
print(sales['revenue_clean'].head())

# Verify that the mean is now computable
print("\nMean revenue (cleaned):", sales['revenue_clean'].mean())"}
